title: Extended Warranty Buy It The Right Way And Save Money
summary: A car owner explains choosing a factory extended warranty based on vehicle complexity and shopping around to cut the dealer's price roughly in half.

assertions.quote: it's got a lot of tech built into it and a lot of things electronic lockers it can go wrong

verdicts.note: Directionally reasonable, but actual failure rates vary a lot by specific model rather than complexity alone.

assertions.quote: your dealer is going to be uh he's going to be 2x the cost of what it really is
they gave me a price of 13... it's basically half the price of what that $2,700 they charge me

verdicts.note: Consistently reported as an effective negotiating tactic by former insiders and consumer surveys.

assertions.quote: this goes from the date you purchase a vehicle

verdicts.note: A standard, verifiable term structure for factory-extension plans.

assertions.quote: they are transferable and they are also pro-rated refundable

verdicts.note: A documented feature of several manufacturer plans (e.g. Mopar).

FTC advises checking "if you're allowed to transfer [the contract] when you sell the vehicle, if there's a fee" -- confirms transfer is a live, sometimes fee-bearing option, but doesn't confirm a pro-rated refund on transfer.
